title_en: Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, Zhang Xiaohong, and Li Jianguo — robbery, theft, harboring, and disposal of stolen goods case
keywords_en: criminal; robbery; theft; harboring; disposal of stolen goods; second instance; intermediate people's court; high people's court; Henan Province; natural person; criminal law; determination of principal offender; elements of the crime of harboring; affirm the original judgment; robbery of firearms and ammunition; theft of liquor; harboring a criminal
full_text_en:
People v. Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, Zhang Xiaohong, and Li Jianguo — case of robbery, theft, harboring, and fencing stolen goods

Defendant: Zhang Jidong, male, born December 31, 1971, native of Kaifeng City, Henan Province, farmer. In October 1990, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of one year and six months for theft. He was arrested on February 25, 1997.

Defendant: Li Rui, male, born May 18, 1975, native of Kaifeng City, Henan Province, unemployed. In September 1991, he was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of three years for theft. He was arrested on February 25, 1997.

Defendant: Zhang Xiaohong, female, born October 23, 1974, native of Kaifeng County, Henan Province, farmer. She was arrested on February 25, 1997.

Defendant: Li Jianguo, male, born October 7, 1968, native of Kaifeng City, Henan Province, formerly a driver for the Shunhe Branch of the Kaifeng Public Security Bureau. He was arrested on February 20, 1997.

The case of defendants Zhang Jidong and Li Rui for robbery and theft, defendant Zhang Xiaohong for harboring, and defendant Li Jianguo for fencing stolen goods was initiated by the Kaifeng City People's Procuratorate, Henan Province, which filed a public prosecution with the Kaifeng Intermediate People's Court.

The Kaifeng Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found the following facts:

In January 1997, defendants Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, and Hou Jun (shot dead while resisting arrest) conspired to rob the firearms of the Dawei Shooting Club located at No. 18, West Section of Binhe Road, Kaifeng City. On the morning of February 10, the three drove a "Changhe" brand minivan, carrying self-made pistols, sledgehammers, daggers, pliers, and other tools for the crime, to scout the vicinity of the shooting club. At approximately 9:00 p.m. that evening, Hou Jun used pliers to cut the lock of the gate of the coal yard adjacent to the east of the club, and the three scaled the wall to enter the premises. They were discovered by duty officer Chen Zhongjing. When Chen opened the door, Hou Jun immediately pressed a pistol against Chen's head, Li Rui grabbed Chen's neck, and the three forcibly escorted Chen into the small room where the safe was kept. Zhang Jidong placed a cleaver against Chen's neck, Li Rui strangled Chen's neck, and Hou Jun struck Chen's head with a sledgehammer, killing Chen. The three then robbed one safe containing firearms and ammunition (valued at RMB 6,500), two cases of bullets, one 74-centimeter Toshiba brand color television (valued at RMB 2,730), and RMB 180 in cash. That night, the three fled to a house rented by Hou at No. 537, Commercial Street, Zhuxian Town, Kaifeng County, where they pried open the safe, which contained one Type 54 pistol, two Type 56 submachine guns, two small-caliber pistols, five small-caliber rifles, one double-barreled shotgun, and more than 5,700 rounds of various types of ammunition.

On February 11, defendant Zhang Xiaohong (Hou Jun's wife) discovered the color television and safe that had been robbed by Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, and Hou Jun. After watching television and learning that the shooting club's firearms and television had been stolen, she tipped off Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, and Hou Jun, accompanied Zhang Jidong and the other two to her parents' home to gather information, and went with them to a field to test-fire the guns. In the early morning of February 13, when public security officers attempted to arrest Zhang Jidong and the other two, Li Rui and Zhang Xiaohong were captured on the spot. Hou Jun, who opened fire to resist arrest, was shot dead on the spot. Zhang Jidong fled with one submachine gun and was arrested the following morning. Police officer Ji Lixin of the Kaifeng County Public Security Bureau sacrificed his life in the course of the arrest operation.

On the night of January 24, 1997, defendants Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, and Hou Jun drove to a warehouse in Zhuxian Town, Kaifeng County, pried open the door and entered, stealing more than 500 cases of various types of liquor (valued at over RMB 19,000). Defendant Li Jianguo, knowing the goods were stolen, actively assisted the three in selling more than 180 cases of liquor, obtaining proceeds of over RMB 3,500, which the four divided and squandered.

The above facts are confirmed by the crime scene investigation records, autopsy conclusions, forensic technical appraisal reports, witness testimony, and defendants' confessions on file.

The Kaifeng Intermediate People's Court held that defendants Zhang Jidong and Li Rui, defying the law of the state, formed a group using violent means to rob firearms, ammunition, and other items, and caused a person's death. Their conduct has constituted the crime of robbery under Article 150 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, constituting a serious case. The two defendants also, by secret means, stole property from others in huge amounts, and their conduct has constituted the crime of theft under Article 152 of the Criminal Law. Zhang Jidong and Li Rui were joint offenders in the crimes of robbery and theft, played principal roles, and were principals. They also committed new crimes after release from reeducation through labor. Therefore, pursuant to Article 22, paragraph 1, and Article 23, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, and Article 2, paragraph 2 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Handling Escaped or Recidivist Reform-through-Labor Offenders and Persons Undergoing Re-education-through-Labor, they should all be given heavier punishments. Zhang Jidong and Li Rui each committed multiple crimes, and should also be subjected to cumulative punishment for multiple crimes under Article 64 of the Criminal Law. Pursuant to Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Zhang Jidong and Li Rui shall have their political rights deprived for life. Pursuant to Article 55, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, their tools used in the crime shall be confiscated. Defendant Zhang Xiaohong, knowing that Zhang Jidong and Li Rui were robbery criminals, still tipped them off and gathered information for them. Her conduct has constituted the crime of harboring under Article 162 of the Criminal Law. Defendant Li Jianguo, knowing that the goods were stolen, still assisted in selling them and participated in dividing the proceeds. His conduct has constituted the crime of fencing stolen goods under Article 172 of the Criminal Law. They should all be punished according to law. Accordingly, on June 5, 1997, the court rendered the following judgment:

1. Defendants Zhang Jidong and Li Rui are convicted of robbery and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; they are convicted of theft and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of nine years. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
2. Defendant Zhang Xiaohong is convicted of harboring and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of three years.
3. Defendant Li Jianguo is convicted of fencing stolen goods and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of two years.
4. The following tools used in the crime are confiscated: one "Changhe" brand minivan, one self-made pistol, one hammer, one pair of pliers, one crowbar, one dagger, and one police uniform.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, defendant Zhang Jidong appealed to the Henan High People's Court on the grounds that he was not a principal and the sentence was too heavy; defendant Li Rui appealed on the ground that he was not a principal; and defendant Zhang Xiaohong appealed on the ground that her conduct did not constitute the crime of harboring.

The Henan High People's Court, after trial, held that the first-instance judgment finding appellants Zhang Jidong and Li Rui guilty of robbery and theft, appellant Zhang Xiaohong guilty of harboring, and defendant Li Jianguo guilty of fencing stolen goods was based on clear facts, conclusive evidence, and was sufficiently established. Zhang Jidong and Li Rui acted actively and cooperated with each other in the crimes of robbery and theft, both playing principal roles, and they were recidivists after release from reeducation through labor; therefore, they should both be severely punished according to law. The grounds for their appeals that they were not principals and the sentences were too heavy were not adopted. Zhang Xiaohong, knowing that Zhang Jidong, Li Rui, and Hou Jun had committed robbery, nevertheless tipped them off and helped gather information; the ground for her appeal that her conduct did not constitute the crime of harboring could not be established and was not adopted. The first-instance judgment had accurate convictions, appropriate sentences, and lawful trial procedures. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 189, item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court rendered the following ruling on June 17, 1997: The appeals were dismissed and the original judgment was affirmed.

Pursuant to the authorization by the Supreme People's Court for High People's Courts to approve certain death penalty cases, the Henan High People's Court, by the same ruling, approved the criminal judgment of the Kaifeng Intermediate People's Court sentencing defendants Zhang Jidong and Li Rui to death for robbery, with deprivation of political rights for life.
